Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, a As Object, s As String, v As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 0.5, 6))
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        v = ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames: s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & ":" & Join(v, ";")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 1
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames = Array("x", "y", "z"): v = ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames: s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & ":" & Join(v, ";")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 2
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames = ws.Range("C2:C4"): v = ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames: s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & ":" & Join(v, ";")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 3
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames = Array(1, 2, 3)
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 4
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames = Array("only")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 5
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames = "abc"
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 6
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlLine: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames = Array("p", "q", "r", "s")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 7
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        v = ch.Axes(2).CategoryNames: s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & ":" & Join(v, ";")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 8
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        v = ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames: s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & ":" & Join(v, ";")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries.Values = Array(1, 2): v = ch.Axes(1).CategoryNames: s = s & "|" & TypeName(v) & ":" & LBound(v) & ":" & UBound(v) & ":" & Join(v, ";")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 10
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).Delete
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 11
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(2).Delete
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 12
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).Delete: ch.HasAxis(1) = True
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 13
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.Axes(1).Delete
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 14
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        Set a = ch.Axes(1): a.Delete: s = s & "|" & a.MajorTickMark
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 15
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).XValues = ws.Range("C2:C4")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 16
        ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Values = ws.Range("C2:C4")
        s = s & "|" & ch.HasAxis(1) & "," & ch.HasAxis(2) & "," & ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "," & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    End Select
    Tried = "ok" & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 16
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
